Rental Benchmark Workbench

For property managers and rental platforms · K-means segmented Random Forest · 83,105 U.S. listing records

Historical benchmark based on 2018–2019 U.S. apartment listings (advertised asking rents, not signed leases or current market values).

Historical Rental Benchmark Explorer

Pick a listing record to see its expected asking rent and 80% benchmark range, then test where a proposed rent would sit. The benchmark depends only on the property, so changing the proposed rent never changes it.

1. Choose a listing record

Custom property attributes require the full Python model (about 200 MB, too large to run in a browser). They are planned for the final version.

Listing Screening Dashboard

A rental platform cannot check every listing by hand. The benchmark ranks listing records by how far their asking rent sits from comparable listings, so reviewers start with the few that need attention.

Overall dataset · fixed

Benchmark error vs simple comparison

Mean absolute error, out-of-fold, same 83,105 records and folds. A single national Random Forest scores $226.

80% range coverage on held-out records

Range factors calibrated on a random half of the records, tested on the other half.
